text: Provides an official CLI to create and manage Slack apps from the command line
quote: The Slack command-line interface (CLI) allows you to create and manage Slack apps from the command line.

text: MCP server lets integrated apps search channels, send messages, and perform other Slack actions via MCP clients
quote: With the Slack MCP server, your integrated apps can search channels, send messages, and perform other Slack actions through MCP clients.

text: MCP server exposes tools for searching, messaging, managing canvases, users, file uploads and lists
quote: The Slack MCP server provides tools for searching through Slack, retrieving and sending messages, managing canvases, managing users, uploading files, and working with lists.

text: Files can be uploaded to Slack via a two-step upload process
quote: Upload files — upload files to Slack via a two-step process. The file isn't visible until the second step completes.

text: Can create and update rich formatted canvas documents programmatically
quote: Create/update a canvas — create and share rich, formatted documents.

text: MCP server can read/write Slack Lists holding structured tabular data with typed columns
quote: The MCP server can work with Slack lists, which hold structured tabular data with typed columns (text, date, select, user, and more)

text: Apps can subscribe to only the specific event types they care about via the Events API
quote: Subscribe to only the events you want; don't worry about the ones you don't need.

text: Events API pushes real-time events to your app via Socket Mode or a public HTTP endpoint
quote: When you use the Events API, _Slack_ calls _you_. ... you can either use Socket Mode or you can designate a public HTTP endpoint

text: Web API is an HTTP RPC-style interface for querying and changing data in a Slack workspace
quote: The Web API is a collection of HTTP RPC-style methods, all with URLs in the form https://slack.com/api/METHOD_FAMILY.method.

text: No-code Workflow Builder lets any user assemble workflows from steps and triggers in Slack
quote: Workflow Builder is a no-code way to build workflows, right in Slack. Any user can combine a limited set of steps and triggers to quickly set up an automation.

text: Workflows can be triggered externally via a webhook
quote: Webhook triggers for workflows - How to start a workflow from outside of Slack.

text: Workflow Builder supports conditional branching based on user responses
quote: Add a branch to a workflow - How to add conditional branching that will present users with different options based on their interaction with the workflow.

text: An AI 'Today' briefing surfaces what needs attention based on your priorities
quote: Today is your new intelligent briefing that signals what needs your attention based on your priorities.

text: Slackbot acts as a personal AI agent that helps prep for meetings, analyze reports, and draft project briefs
quote: Slackbot is your personal AI agent in Slack that understands you and your workspace, helping you prepare for upcoming meetings, analyze reports, and create project briefs.

text: AI in Slack summarizes channels and threads and produces daily recaps
quote: AI in Slack can summarize channels and threads and serve up daily recaps, giving you the information you need to stay organized and in the know.

text: Everything shared or integrated in Slack (docs, PDFs, CRM records, decks) is searchable
quote: Conversations with coworkers, PDFs, images for your social campaign, decks buried in Google Drive, support tickets, customer records from Salesforce; if it’s shared in or integrated into Slack, it’s searchable.

text: AI can translate conversations into any language
quote: Create time-saving automations in a few clicks, translate conversations into any language, and even use AI to take meeting notes.

text: AI automatically takes meeting notes, key takeaways and action items during huddles
quote: AI in Slack keeps you focused on the conversation by taking notes for you. Key takeaways, action items, and who said what are all neatly organized when the huddle ends

text: Users can instantly start an audio/video huddle from a channel or DM
quote: Simply click on the headphones icon in the conversation header to start a huddle with your team.

text: Links, documents and messages shared during a huddle are automatically saved afterward
quote: If it's shared in a huddle, it's saved in Slack. Any links, documents, and messages shared during a huddle are automatically saved once the huddle ends

text: App Directory offers 2,600+ prebuilt integrations like Salesforce, Jira, Google Drive, ChatGPT
quote: Choose from over 2,600 apps in the Slack App Directory — from Salesforce, Jira, Google Drive, ChatGPT, and more.

text: Workspace admins can export their workspace's data
quote: Export your workspace data | Slack

text: Offers a virtual collaborative space for teams to co-create live together
quote: Bring the feeling of working side-by-side to a virtual space that lets you collaborate and co-create live.

text: Coding agents can collaborate with an entire team inside Slack, not just a single user
quote: Coding agents can now work with your whole team, not just you.

text: Users can update CRM deals just by asking Slackbot in natural language
quote: Update deals just by asking Slackbot

text: Users can get fast answers inside Slack via a built-in Claude AI integration
quote: Get fast answers with Claude

text: Unlimited message history keeps every message and file fully searchable
quote:
Unlimited message history

Every message, file, and conversation shared in Slack is saved and fully searchable.
